pages.title: Where to find
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Volcano.

pages.title: How to fight
pages.text: Craft Ominous Catalyst from Amber Curiosity and Heavy Bones. Throw it toward the Volcanic Core inside the volcano: the core attracts the item and consumes one after a successful summon. Prepare Fire Resistance, healing and room to evade falling tephra.

pages.title: What does not work
pages.text: It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Tectonic Shard. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory. In an active campaign this main-boss victory is linked to the Exotic Eye. First record the branch victories: Skeletosaurus. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.
